fs-20260823.description: Operator-assisted capture session (035-004), 2026-08-23 ~16:50-16:54 PDT, daylight/late-afternoon. Populated from live daemon polls ('aprilcam camera tags <slug>', several polls per camera to clear the confirmation-grace window) taken immediately before and after each camera's capture run, plus each run's own baseline detection count. STAKEHOLDER-CONFIRMED 2026-08-23: (1) tags present -- AprilTag 1 + ArUco 1-10, machine-observed consistently across every poll of this capture session; (2) AprilTags 10, 11, 15, 100 are known transients -- stakeholder confirmed directly and they are deliberately excluded from every list below even though none were observed this session regardless; (3) the 6 rectangles and 8 dots at their surveyed positions -- this had been the one genuinely open item, carried forward from an earlier handoff note rather than freshly checked, but the stakeholder states the rectangles and dots are physically glued to the top of the workbench and cannot move, so the survey positions remain valid by construction and stand confirmed. IMPORTANT: expected detections are genuinely per-camera (see 'per_camera' below) -- the flat visible_* arrays here are the UNION across all three cameras' fields of view, not what any single camera sees. Rectangle/dot IDs are the full main-playfield.json survey (6 rectangles, 8 dots).

arducam-ov9281-usb-camera.note: AprilTag 1 and ArUco 2-6,8-10 detected reliably every poll. ArUco 1 and ArUco 7 (far corners, per stakeholder) are INTERMITTENT on this camera -- seen in most but not all of a 5-poll priming sequence and in the capture run's own baseline poll (11 total = 1 AprilTag + all 10 ArUco), but dropped out on at least one poll each. Treat ArUco 1/7 recall on this camera as a documented boundary case, not a hard 100%-recall expectation, until a longer confirmation run settles it.

arducam-ov9782-usb-camera.note: Full field visible -- all 10 ArUco + AprilTag 1 detected consistently across 5 priming polls and the capture run's own baseline poll.

hd-usb-camera.note: No AprilTag in view; ArUco 5-10 not in view either -- stakeholder confirms this camera simply has few field markers in its FOV on the secondary playfield, not a defect. Consistent across priming polls and the capture run's own baseline poll.
